sam_marketing: Quick sync HarborEdge interview + whiteboard captured today. Recording, transcript, and storyboard frames uploaded: https://drive.redwood/harboredge. Need: final quote, logo/release, storyboard approval for hero shot, and webinar routing. Target embargo: Apr 28.

toni_growth: Love the "developer-friendly SDK integration" anecdote. Growth wants the hero to call out stability under sustained load and route registrants into the mid-market demo queue. Use utm=harboredge_story.

drew_prod: We sketched a short timeline slide showing rollout + perf delta (no raw numbers). Can produce a sanitized P95 chart if they OK. Also captured a clear technical soundbite about KV-cache hit rates.

alana_legal: Please attach the signed media release and confirm logo usage scope. Important: no exact % reductions or customer billing figures without explicit written sign-off. Ill send a one-click approval template to their counsel.

sam_marketing: Release uploaded and I dropped three quote variants + storyboard frames here: https://drive.redwood/harboredge/quotes_and_frames. I mocked 2 hero headlines: stat & qualitative.

pete_design: Once copy is locked Ill finalize the hero storyboard (desktop + mobile frames) and produce a 20s motion clip for socials. Need embargo date + final CTA to size assets. Asset freeze set two days before embargo.

viv_sales: Routing: tag registrants with "harboredge-web" and add prospect-segment=midmarket. Sales cadence: AE outreach within 48h for attendees who request a trial or view >50% of the recording. Also request gated appendix for full integration notes (sales-only).

press-relay-bot: Reminder: asset upload deadline for this thread is timestamp 1717092000 (Apr 26 17:00 UTC).

alana_legal: Small legal note  avoid comparative claims like "X% cheaper than vendor Y" unless HarborEdge provides written evidence. If they provide numbers, please forward the confirmation email to me for redline.

drew_prod: We can produce two versions of the rollout timeline: 1) public-friendly (no numbers) for the hero, 2) detailed appendix with methodology and anonymized metrics for gated download. That keeps the story credible without exposing customer data.

toni_growth: Recommend webinar Tues Apr 30 at 10am PT (APAC-friendly evening). Primary CTA: "Register for the HarborEdge webinar". Secondary CTA in follow-up emails: "Request the integration appendix (sales)".

sam_marketing: Derek (HarborEdge infra lead) okayed the concise exec quote: "Redwood made our inference stable as demand scaled." Hell have a short legal approval on logo and numbers by Friday.

pete_design: Ill start the hero frames using the qualitative headline and swap in the stat headline if we get numeric sign-off. Uploading drafts by Apr 24.

viv_sales: One routing add: please include a hidden field in the registration form to capture "sdk_interest=true" so we can route SDK-specific leads to the developer solutions team.

sam_marketing: Good call. Action items: @alana_legal send approval template to their counsel, @drew_prod prep sanitized chart + appendix, @pete_design mock hero frames, @viv_sales confirm SFDC queue mapping. Ill lock promo copy once we have the final sentence + legal ok and post final assets in this thread. :sparkles:
